select * from ( select a.PLO_NUM,a.sign_num,nvl( b.study_num, 0 ) AS STUDY_NUM,nvl( b.hours, 0 ) AS HOURS,nvl( c.coin, 0 ) AS COIN,nvl( b.hours, 0 ) * nvl( c.coin, 0 ) AS POINT from (select plo_num,count(1) as sign_num from TRM_COURSE_SIGN where status > 0 group by plo_num) a left join (select plo_num, count( * ) AS study_num,sum( hours ) hours from TRM_STUDY_LOG where study_comp = 1 group by PLO_NUM ) b on (a.PLO_NUM = b.PLO_NUM) left join (select plo_num,sum( coin ) AS coin from TRM_STUDY_LOG WHERE COURSE_PASS=1 group by plo_num ) c on (a.PLO_NUM = c.PLO_NUM) left join (select plo_num from cus_emp_info where plo_status = '00' ) d on (a.PLO_NUM = d.PLO_NUM) where d.plo_num is not null order by point desc )
where rownum < #{allFlag,jdbcType=DECIMAL}

select a.PLO_NUM,a.sign_num,nvl( b.study_num, 0 ) AS STUDY_NUM,nvl( b.hours, 0 ) AS HOURS,nvl( c.coin, 0 ) AS COIN,nvl( b.hours, 0 ) * nvl( c.coin, 0 ) AS POINT from (select plo_num,count(1) as sign_num from TRM_COURSE_SIGN where status > 0 and PLO_NUM = #{ploNum,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by plo_num) a left join (SELECT plo_num, count( * ) AS study_num,sum( hours ) hours FROM TRM_STUDY_LOG WHERE PLO_NUM = #{ploNum,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and study_comp = 1 group by PLO_NUM ) b on (a.PLO_NUM = b.PLO_NUM) left join (select plo_num,sum( coin ) AS coin from TRM_STUDY_LOG WHERE COURSE_PASS=1 and PLO_NUM = #{ploNum,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by plo_num ) c on (a.PLO_NUM = c.PLO_NUM) order by point desc
